Team —

As we lock in logistics for the Acme executive workshop (June 24-25), I want to confirm the attendee tech brief and backstage credential flow so we have a single source of truth for ops and vendor handoff. Key asks below — please reply inline with any constraints or changes by EOD Thursday so I can send the external confirmation to GrandHotel and Acme.

High level:
- Arrival windows: VIPs arrive 08:15-09:00 on 6/24 (private check-in). All other attendees arrive 08:30-09:30.
- Backstage credentials: two-tier badges — "Crew/Vendor" (red lanyard) and "Staff" (blue). Attendee badges are white.
- Badging handoff: badges printed on-site; we need final roster by 6/18 noon. See attached attendee_roster_v4.csv and badge-printing-specs.pdf.

Technical items we need to confirm internally:
1) Network: static IP allocations for the sponsor demo booth and two vendor encoders, VLAN for broadcast gear. (Laura, can you confirm port counts and where the patch panel access will be?)
2) AV: mic types for the roundtable and breakout rooms, lav/handheld count, and console operator window. (Hannah, please attach mic_map_v2.pdf and confirm mics + wireless channels.)
3) Backstage access: who is the single point to sign badges and that person’s phone number for arrivals. (Logan, you will run FOH but confirm backup.)
4) Vendor access list: Starlight AV crew (Ops contact below) need temp access to the ballroom electrical rooms for load-in 06/23 18:00–21:00.

Attachments: attendee_roster_v4.csv, badge-printing-specs.pdf

Example success criteria: badge print test completed 6/23 20:00; network tags verified; mic checks complete by 07:00 on event day.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Quick network update / constraints:
- Ballroom MDF will provide a 48-port PoE switch stack with two 10Gb uplinks. I can reserve 6 static IPs for sponsor demo + 2 for encoder devices; see network-alloc.xlsx attached for the port mapping.
- We will require a tagged VLAN for broadcast traffic (VLAN 210). The hotel will place the bridge on an L3 peer — latency looks good from their uplink.
- Patch panel access: labeled rack A-2 on loading dock 3; we will have an on-call network eng (Karthik) during load-in.

Notes: If Starlight needs additional throughput beyond 300 Mbps burst, we should get a prior approval from the hotel; let me know and I’ll escalate.

Adding AV run-of-show and mic plan here. See mic_map_v2.pdf (attached) — short summary below: 
- Main roundtable (theatre-style for execs): 1 console, 4 boundary mics, 2 wireless lavs for presenters, 2 handhelds for audience Q&A.
- Breakout A/B: 1 talkback line each, 1 tabletop mic per table (x6), two wireless channels reserved for live translation if needed.
- Wireless channels: recommend channels 12 & 17 to avoid hotel cordless interference; Starlight to confirm.
- Console operator window: we need a 2m x 1.5m clear workspace at FOH with sightline to stage; power / data at rack location is confirmed by Laura.

Schedule constraint: mic checks must be complete by 07:00 on 6/24 for a 08:00 rehearsal with the Acme AV lead. Starlight confirmed availability 06/23 19:00–21:00 for load-in tests.

Hannah Schmitt
AV Production Lead
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
